section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the reason for the quality of self-nullification specifically in the earth and the inanimate realm is that their root precedes the heavens and the vegetative realm, and likewise Malchus is in a state of nullification because its root is in Kesser, above the root of Zeir Anpin.
section.t: Now, it is explained in Torah Ohr there,
that the reason for this, that specifically in the land there is the matter of nullification
[that the land is a footstool under the soles of all feet]
is because in thought, the land preceded the heavens.
And likewise, regarding the nullification that is in the inanimate,
that the inanimate is in a state of nullification
[for the matter of the vegetative is that it grows in height and haughtiness,
and the matter of nullification is specifically in the inanimate],
is because the root of the inanimate is above the root of the vegetative.
And likewise, regarding Zeir Anpin and Malchus
[which are analogous to the heavens and the earth,
the inanimate and the vegetative],
that Malchus is in a state of nullification is because its root is in Kesser
(above the root of Zeir Anpin).

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the analogy of the Sefirah of Malchus to the power of speech in the soul relates to its nullification, which has two aspects: speech is not a matter of loftiness, and it involves the speaker nullifying himself for the sake of another, as hinted in the name Yehudah meaning admission and nullification.
section.t: And it can be said,
that this, that the analogy for the Sefirah of Malchus among the soul powers is the power of speech,
also relates to the nullification of Malchus.
And it can be said,
that in the nullification that is in speech,
there are two matters.
That speech is not a matter of loftiness.
For the matter of all the [other] powers is that they reveal the soul,
a matter of loftiness and perfection,
but the power of speech, which is not a revelation of the soul,
is not a matter of loftiness.
And there is another matter in the nullification that is in speech,
that the matter of speech is that the speaking person goes out of his own existence
(nullifies himself)
for the sake of another.
And likewise, regarding the nullification of Malchus,
that in addition to the fact that Malchus is not a matter of revelation,
it descends to enliven and bring into being the creations26.
And it can be said,
that this nullification in Malchus is hinted at in what is stated in Torah Ohr, that Yehudah
(Malchus)
is a term of admission and nullification,
for the nullification of admission is that one nullifies himself to the one to whom he admits.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that by bringing intellect and emotions into speech, they are enhanced because the root of speech is in the essence of the soul, though the level of the soul from which intellect and emotions are drawn through speech is lower than the level from which speech itself is drawn.
section.t: Now, it is known27,
that by a person bringing the intellect
(which he grasped in his thought)
into speech,
there is an addition in the intellect beyond what it was initially
(in thought).
And so it is with the emotions,
that by speaking words of love, there is an addition in his love.
And so it is with the other emotions.
And the reason for this is,
because the root of speech is in the essence of the soul,
and therefore,
by the drawing down and enclothing of the intellect and emotions in speech,
their drawing down from the soul is from a more elevated place.
And it can be said,
that also the level of the soul from which the intellect and emotions are drawn through their enclothing in speech is lower than the level of the soul from which speech itself is drawn28.
For this, that the intellect and emotions
(the revelations of the soul)
are drawn down and enclothed in speech, is by means of the matter of the potential of the soul to descend downward, downward being drawn into them.
For although even this matter in the soul is at a level of the soul that is above the root of the intellect and emotions
[therefore,
by drawing down this level,
there is an addition in the intellect and emotions],
nevertheless,
this matter in the soul
(that it has the potential to descend downward, downward)
is a level of its revelation.
But the root of the power of speech itself
(which is not a matter of revelation),
its root is in the essence of the soul.
